01 — About

Skills built for real data problems.

I'm Rojeh Tamer Raouf Hanna, a data analyst most at home in data analysis — the stage where numbers turn into something a client can actually use.

I work the full pipeline: cleaning messy datasets, designing relational databases in SQL Server, analyzing with Python, and shipping the result as an interactive Power BI dashboard. Recent work spans a 13-million-row road accident model, a sales dashboard tracking $154M in revenue, and a relational engine that links clinical and nutrition data to generate diet recommendations.

I take on freelance work for clients who need a clear read on their data — not just a chart, but a chart that answers the question you actually had.

03 — Services

How I can help.

Dashboard design

Interactive Power BI dashboards with clear KPIs, drill-downs, and filters built around the questions you need answered — not just the data you happen to have.

Data cleaning & preprocessing

Messy, inconsistent, or incomplete data made analysis-ready — missing values handled, types corrected, formats standardized.

Database design

Relational schemas in SQL Server, including lookup and bridge tables, for data that needs to connect across more than one source.

Exploratory analysis & reporting

Python-based analysis with pandas and Seaborn, delivered as clear visual insight — not a wall of numbers.

Custom data pipelines

Connecting unrelated datasets that share no natural key into a single, queryable system.

Power BI

US Road Accident Analytics Dashboard

An interactive dashboard analyzing 13M+ US traffic accident records from 2016–2023. Tracks total accidents, average severity, visibility, and weekend-accident rates, broken down by month, road feature, severity level, and day/night conditions — with state, severity, and year filters for drill-down.

SQL Server · Python

Data-Driven Diabetes Diet Recommendation System

Connected two unrelated Kaggle datasets — 768 diabetes patient records and 335 food items — that shared no natural key. Cleaned both, designed a relational schema with lookup and bridge tables, then used SQL to classify patient risk and food suitability, and Python to visualize the results and generate personalized diet recommendations.

Power BI

Customer Demographics Dashboard

A segmentation dashboard built from applicant data — gender, age, education, income type, family status, and years employed. KPI cards sit alongside a gender-split donut, family and income breakdowns, and an age-vs-family-size scatter, all filterable by gender, age, and education.

Power BI

Sales Performance Dashboard

Tracks $154M+ in revenue and $57M in profit across three channels — Wholesale, Distributor, and Export — from 2017 to 2019. Combines top-line KPIs with a monthly sales-and-profit trend, a channel-split donut, a sales-vs-profit correlation by customer, and a ranked product profitability chart, plus a full customer table for drill-down.
